note: THE single evaluation on test run 0057 with frozen choices

mismatch.designs: LMMSE for assumed SNR a: main.baselines_run loading for a; SNR-aware MLPs get a; mlp_blind ignores it

joint.gmm_config: per seed and row, the (K, alpha) that seed chose on validation; refit must reproduce model_sha256

claims.rule: one rule for every gain g (seed averages; positive = better): 'better' iff ci_excludes_zero = +1 and g >= margin; 'significant but negligible' iff ci_excludes_zero = +1 and g < margin (or -1 and g > -margin); 'worse' iff ci_excludes_zero = -1 and g <= -margin; 'equivalent' iff the whole CI lies inside [-margin, +margin]; otherwise 'inconclusive'

primary.M1: 64-subcarrier line: 'no learned estimator beats LMMSE' holds iff no (variant, density, SNR) cell of the 4 MLP variants x 3 densities x 7 SNRs is 'better' than LMMSE
primary.J1: joint setting: 'the GMM beats joint LMMSE' holds in a row iff the GMM's gain over LMMSE is 'better'; claimed for all rows only if all 8 rows (2 patterns x 4 SNRs) hold
primary.J2: joint setting: 'the GMM beats joint MLP v' holds in a row iff gmm@mean_gain_over_<v>@mean_db is 'better'; reported per row and claimed for all rows only if all 8 rows hold, for each v

claims.ci_family: seed averages (@mean) carry the claims; per-seed results are descriptive
claims.multiplicity: counts of CIs that exclude zero are descriptive and not adjusted for multiplicity
claims.block_robustness: if ci95_200snap and ci95 lead to different categories for a primary claim, the report gives both
descriptive_only: SNR-mismatch losses (offsets, worst case, fixed design)

validation_only.space32 GMM (experiment 06): 32-antenna denoising; not part of the report's comparison
validation_only.position genie (experiment 03): uses the true position; a diagnostic, not a receiver

definitions.nmse_db: 10 log10(sum of squared errors / sum of squared entries) over the withheld entries of all evaluated vectors; 3 decimals (as the validation records, so the rehearsal can compare)
definitions.ci95: paired block bootstrap over the evaluated 50-snapshot blocks, B=2000, numpy default_rng(0); the 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles; 4 decimals
definitions.ci95_200snap: the same with the evaluated blocks of each 200-snapshot window of the run merged (block index // 4; all 4 blocks on the test run, the 2 odd ones in an odd-block rehearsal; default_rng(1)): a robustness check of the CI against correlation between neighbouring blocks
definitions.ci_excludes_zero: from the UNROUNDED percentiles: +1 if the CI lies above 0, -1 below 0, 0 otherwise
definitions.<k>_gain_over_lmmse_db: NMSE(LMMSE) - NMSE(k) from unrounded NMSEs, 4 decimals; positive = k better
definitions.gmm@mean_gain_over_<v>@mean_db: NMSE(<v>@mean) - NMSE(gmm@mean); positive = the GMM better
definitions.<k>@mean: seed average: per-block squared errors averaged over the seeds, then NMSE (an average model, NOT averaged predictions)
definitions.mismatch: experiment 04's summarize() on the true x assumed grid: gains from unrounded NMSEs (3 decimals), gain CIs to 4 decimals with gain_ci_excludes_zero from the unrounded percentiles; B=2000 here (04 used 1000)
